title: bread2gnosispay
tagline: A community token to Gnosis Pay pipeline, for the Breadchain Cooperative

prizes.title: Yield Bearing Tokens Integration with Gnosis Pay

description:
This interface empower community members, breadchain member projects, and cooperative contributors to redeem their $BREAD using Gnosis Pay. A community-maintained liquidity pool provides Monerium swaps, transferring $BREAD  holdings to a Gnosis Pay address.  
With Gnosis Pay $BREAD is more easily utilized for cooperative operations and engagement with bread is made simpler for community members.
how_its_made:
Gnosis, Gnosis Pay, Curve.fi, Foundry, ethers.js, Metamask, Monerium .
All on-chain elements were deployed and verified to Gnosis chain using Foundry. Curve.fi's deployments on Gnosis enabled providing a liquidity pool for $BREAD robustly and simply. A simple HTML template is provided, easily implementable for other Gnosis ecosystem communities wishing to integrate their community token with Gnosis Pay.
